title: Executive report from seeded data
objective: Measure whether the data-to-report craftbook analyzes seeded data first and produces a narrative report grounded in computed figures.
prompt: In the `Data to Report Eval` project, read `data/returns-summary.csv` and write `tasks/eval/report.md`: an executive report for support leadership. Include an executive summary, key metrics table, findings, segment trends, recommendations, and limitations. Ground every claim in the seeded figures.

setup.about: Self-contained eval project for the data-to-report craftbook. The dataset is workspace/data/returns-summary.csv.
